description: This Java class 'UpdatingInjectorService' extends 'SettingInjectorService' and provides a service that updates its setting summary periodically by broadcasting an intent with the current system time. It overrides methods to provide the current status and always reports as enabled.

classes.name: UpdatingInjectorService
classes.description: A service extending SettingInjectorService that updates its setting status periodically via broadcasts.

methods.name: UpdatingInjectorService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a specific tag for identification.

methods.name: onGetSummary
methods.description: Overrides parent to broadcast a status change and return the current system time as a string.

methods.name: onGetEnabled
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the service is enabled.
